description.en: Selection of patients for POEM based on manometric subtype (Chicago achalasia type I/II/III, spastic disorders), prior interventions, and comorbidity.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for poem case selection but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs poem case selection independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches poem case selection to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
